# Flow diagram: Ledgerly

## Send an invoice

`FLW-send-invoice` · verifiable (claims specified) · From the owner confirming a finished draft to the client's email being handed to the provider.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph lane_ACT_account_owner ["Account owner"]
    s_review{"Checks the recipient, the<br/>totals and the due date, then<br/>confirms"}
  end
  subgraph lane__ ["No actor named"]
    s_check_limit{"The system checks that the<br/>workspace is under its monthly<br/>invoice limit"}
    s_send["The system takes the next<br/>invoice number, marks the<br/>invoice sent and queues the<br/>email, in one transaction"]
    s_deliver{"A background job hands the<br/>email with the private pay<br/>link to the delivery provider"}
    s_done(["The owner sees the invoice as<br/>sent"])
    s_undelivered(["The owner is told delivery<br/>failed, and can correct the<br/>address and send it again with<br/>the same number"])
    s_blocked(["The owner sees the monthly<br/>limit and an upgrade prompt;<br/>the draft is kept"])
    s_cancelled(["Nothing changes; the draft<br/>stays as it was"])
  end
  t_FLW_send_invoice(["The owner chooses Send on a<br/>finished draft"])
  t_FLW_send_invoice --> s_review
  s_review -->|"The owner confirms"| s_check_limit
  s_review -->|"The owner goes back to<br/>edit"| s_cancelled
  s_check_limit -->|"The workspace is under<br/>the limit"| s_send
  s_check_limit -->|"The workspace is at the<br/>limit"| s_blocked
  s_send --> s_deliver
  s_deliver -->|"The provider accepts the<br/>message"| s_done
  s_deliver -->|"The provider rejects it<br/>or the address bounces"| s_undelivered
  classDef success fill:#d4f4dd,stroke:#2e7d32;
  classDef failure fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#c62828;
  classDef abort fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b;
  classDef decision fill:#e7f0fe,stroke:#3b6fb6;
  class s_done success;
  class s_undelivered failure;
  class s_blocked,s_cancelled abort;
  class s_review,s_check_limit,s_deliver decision;
```

| Step | Actor | What happens | Where | Uses | Data | Emits | Then |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `review` | Account owner | Checks the recipient, the totals and the due date, then confirms | Invoice review | How an invoice total is calculated |  |  | decide: The owner confirms / The owner goes back to edit |
| `check-limit` |  | The system checks that the workspace is under its monthly invoice limit |  |  |  |  | decide: The workspace is under the limit / The workspace is at the limit |
| `send` |  | The system takes the next invoice number, marks the invoice sent and queues the email, in one transaction |  | How an invoice number is formed | Invoice (update) | Invoice sent | → `deliver` |
| `deliver` |  | A background job hands the email with the private pay link to the delivery provider |  | Email sending |  |  | decide: The provider accepts the message / The provider rejects it or the address bounces |
| `done` |  | The owner sees the invoice as sent |  |  |  |  | end: success |
| `undelivered` |  | The owner is told delivery failed, and can correct the address and send it again with the same number |  |  |  |  | end: failure |
| `blocked` |  | The owner sees the monthly limit and an upgrade prompt; the draft is kept |  |  |  |  | end: abort |
| `cancelled` |  | Nothing changes; the draft stays as it was |  |  |  |  | end: abort |

## Pay an invoice online

`FLW-pay-invoice` · verifiable (claims specified) · From the client opening the private link to a recorded payment and a receipt.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph lane_ACT_client ["Client"]
    s_view["Reads the invoice and chooses<br/>Pay"]
    s_choose_amount{"Keeps the full balance or<br/>enters a smaller amount"}
    s_receipt(["Sees the receipt and is<br/>emailed a copy"])
  end
  subgraph lane__ ["No actor named"]
    s_invalid_amount["The page explains the allowed<br/>range and asks again"]
    s_pay{"The client is taken to the<br/>payment provider's page and<br/>enters card details there"}
    s_record["The system records the<br/>payment, reduces the balance<br/>and marks the invoice paid<br/>when nothing is left"]
    s_declined(["The page shows what happened<br/>and offers to try again with<br/>the same link"])
    s_provider_down(["The page says paying is<br/>unavailable and shows the<br/>owner's bank details"])
  end
  t_FLW_pay_invoice(["The client opens the private<br/>link in the invoice email"])
  t_FLW_pay_invoice --> s_view
  s_view --> s_choose_amount
  s_choose_amount -->|"The amount is valid"| s_pay
  s_choose_amount -->|"The amount is above the<br/>balance or not positive"| s_invalid_amount
  s_invalid_amount --> s_choose_amount
  s_pay -->|"The provider reports the<br/>card was charged"| s_record
  s_pay -->|"The card is declined or<br/>the client leaves"| s_declined
  s_pay -->|"The provider is<br/>unavailable"| s_provider_down
  s_record --> s_receipt
  classDef success fill:#d4f4dd,stroke:#2e7d32;
  classDef failure fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#c62828;
  classDef abort fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b;
  classDef decision fill:#e7f0fe,stroke:#3b6fb6;
  class s_receipt success;
  class s_declined failure;
  class s_provider_down abort;
  class s_choose_amount,s_pay decision;
```

| Step | Actor | What happens | Where | Uses | Data | Emits | Then |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `view` | Client | Reads the invoice and chooses Pay | Pay page |  | Invoice (read) |  | → `choose-amount` |
| `choose-amount` | Client | Keeps the full balance or enters a smaller amount | Pay page | A payment is positive and no more than the balance |  |  | decide: The amount is valid / The amount is above the balance or not positive |
| `invalid-amount` |  | The page explains the allowed range and asks again |  |  |  |  | → `choose-amount` |
| `pay` |  | The client is taken to the payment provider's page and enters card details there |  | Payment provider hosted checkout |  |  | decide: The provider reports the card was charged / The card is declined or the client leaves / The provider is unavailable |
| `record` |  | The system records the payment, reduces the balance and marks the invoice paid when nothing is left |  |  | Payment (create), Invoice (update) | Payment received, Invoice paid | → `receipt` |
| `receipt` | Client | Sees the receipt and is emailed a copy | Pay page |  |  |  | end: success |
| `declined` |  | The page shows what happened and offers to try again with the same link |  |  |  |  | end: failure |
| `provider-down` |  | The page says paying is unavailable and shows the owner's bank details |  |  |  |  | end: abort |
